SELECT STM.name AS typeName, GCM_A.value_1 AS assetStatus, GCM_P.value_1 AS paymentStatus, VM.name AS vendorName, IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(SM.expiry_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '-') AS expiryDateString, CASE WHEN SM.rent_flg THEN '4' ELSE '1' END AS rentStatus,
SM.serial_no AS serialNo, SM.name AS stockName, SM.model, SM.maker, SM.stock_type AS stockType, -- 分類種別 SM.stock_code AS stockCode, -- 分類コード SM.rent_flg AS rentFlg, -- 貸出可否 SM.asset_type AS assetType, -- 資産区分 SM.vendor_code AS vendorCode, -- 貸出会社コード SM.expiry_date AS expiryDate, -- 契約満了日 SM.pay_cycle AS payCycle, -- 支払区分 SM.price, -- 料金 SM.remarks, -- 備考 SM.del AS delFlg -- 削除フラグ FROM stock_master SM LEFT JOIN stock_type_master STM ON SM.stock_type = STM.stock_type AND SM.stock_code = STM.stock_code LEFT JOIN vendor_master VM ON SM.vendor_code = VM.code LEFT JOIN generic_code_master GCM_A ON GCM_A.generic_key = 'ASSET_TYPE' AND SM.asset_type = GCM_A.type_key LEFT JOIN generic_code_master GCM_P ON GCM_P.generic_key = 'PAY_CYCLE' AND SM.pay_cycle = GCM_P.type_key
AND STM.id = #{type}
AND SM.serial_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{serialNo}, '%')
AND SM.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND SM.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model}, '%')
AND SM.rent_flg = #{status}
AND SM.del = TRUE
ORDER BY SM.serial_no
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_master WHERE 1 = 1 AND serial_no = #{serialNo} ) AS IS_EXISTS
